title:
Fix crosslink #275 (HIGH, anti-Goodhart soundness hole): the solver-vacuity checks silently no-op on every struct/enum-returning fn. ENVIRONMENT (use directly): Verus at /Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus — for the gauntlet: export VERUS_BIN=/Users/maxine/verus-dist/verus-arm64-macos/verus and add its dir to PATH; lake at /Users/maxine/.elan/bin. New verus/lake tests use the EXISTING verus_present()/lake_present() skip-guards.

THE BUG (two coupled defects in forge/src/vacuity_solver.rs): (1) extract_lowered_fn (~line 311) builds the tautology/vacuous-precondition harness from spec_items + the target fn but does NOT weave in the reachable struct/enum (ADT) declarations the fn references, so an ADT-returning/ADT-taking fn's harness fails to COMPILE with E0425. (2) interpret_summary (~line 595) maps success:false / errors:0 to HarnessOutcome::Failed, read as a CLEAN pass — so the E0425 compile error reads as 'not a tautology / not vacuous' and BOTH checks silently no-op. Every ADT-returning fn bypasses both anti-Goodhart vacuity checks (R-CODE-4 'non-verdict read as clean').

Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit. STANDING SELF-VERIFY: python3 tooling/doc-drift.py and RE-PIN the audited-sha of EVERY design doc whose governed source you touch; req-registry.py --check; finish 0-drift.

SCOPE: the #275 fix ONLY (NOT #271). Two parts: (1) WEAVE ADT DEPS — extend the harness sub-program to include the struct/enum defs reachable from the target fn's signature + body (mirror the existing reachable SPEC-FN deps weave; extend to ADTs or add a reachable_adt_deps pass); the ADT-returning fn's harness must now COMPILE. (2) SEPARATE COMPILE-ERROR FROM VERIFICATION-FAILED — a harness that fails to COMPILE/elaborate (E0425, unresolved name, parse/VIR error) is a HARNESS CONSTRUCTION error → a loud ForgeError, NEVER Failed→Clean; only a genuine verus 'failed' (harness compiled, obligation checked-and-not-proved) is the Failed/Clean signal. Preserve the inverted-verdict logic (tautology: empty-body harness PROVES → reject; vacuous req: assert(false) PROVES → reject).

TESTS (verus_present-guarded): an ADT-returning fn with a body-ignoring/tautological ens is REJECTED as a tautology (not silently clean); a vacuous-precondition ADT-taking fn is rejected; an unconstructable harness surfaces a ForgeError, never clean. Pre-existing scalar path byte-unchanged (existing vacuity conformance certs byte-identical).

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p forge (VERUS_BIN set as above); clippy -p forge --all-targets -- -D warnings; fmt --check; doc-drift 0-drift; req-registry --check clean; conformance oracle byte-identical. No stubs/TODOs.

SCOPE GUARDS: no cage change; do NOT flip the README headline; never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json or .claude/settings.json. git push is blocked — commit locally, end with a summary, the orchestrator pushes. One branch; ONE fix (#275).
